Firecrawl's $75 million Series B was led by Smash Capital (some outlets write "Smash Ventures"), announced around September 22, 2026. Other investors included Altos Ventures, Nexus Venture Partners, Y Combinator, Freestyle, and Offline Ventures. The raise came alongside the launch of Alexandria, a data service for AI agents. No valuation was disclosed.

The sources disagree on a few details:
- **Series A:** One source puts it at $20.7M, another at $14.5M.
- **Headquarters:** One source lists Los Angeles, another San Francisco.
- **Founding year:** One source says 2024, another says 2022.
- **Amount:** An SEC Form D reported in one article shows about $82 million in preferred stock sold, about $7.1 million more than the announced $75 million. The filing didn't name investors or label the round, and the company hasn't explained the gap.

content.text:
Firecrawl raised **$75 million** in its Series B. **Smash Capital** led it (some outlets write "Smash Ventures"). The company announced the round around September 22, 2026, and launched **Alexandria** alongside it. Alexandria is a data library for AI agents, meant to turn web crawling into a knowledge source they can use.

Other investors included Altos Ventures, Nexus Venture Partners, Y Combinator, Freestyle and Offline Ventures. No valuation was disclosed.

I only ran one search and didn't open the articles, so the details come from search-result summaries, and those disagree in places. One article cites an SEC Form D showing about $82 million in preferred stock sold, roughly $7 million more than the announced $75 million. The filing doesn't name investors or label the round, and the gap is unexplained.

- [Web-Scraping Firm Firecrawl Raises $75M Series B Led by Smash Ventures for AI-Agent Data](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/web-scraping-firm-firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-led-by-smash-ventures-for-ai)
- [Dealroom: Firecrawl raises $75M Series B to build a knowledge library for AI agents](https://dealroom.co/news/155341-firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-to-build-a-knowledge-library-for-ai-agents/)
